verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a fair axis for a data orchestration platform, but the evidence pack documents no assistant inside the Dagster UI or product. The only AI items are an AI skill for external coding agents and a Dagster+ MCP server for external AI sessions. Both are adjacent integrations with outside agents, not an in-product assistant you can delegate tasks to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
